subject: general
question: In which year was the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1985.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) was established on** 8th December 1985.**

 
• The Charter was signed by the leaders of eight South Asian nations- Bangladesh, Bhutan, Afghanistan, Maldives, Nepal, India, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka.
 
• SAARC is currently focusing on regional cooperation in all fields of development activity that impact the livelihood of people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• SAARC is headquartered in** Kathmandu, Nepal.**
 
• It was established in 1985 in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
 
• It has **8 nations as its members and there are 9 observers.**
 
• The 8th member to join SAARC was Afghanistan in the year 2007.
